style_summary: Part 5 of Chromatic Gesture Characters: carries the exaggerated geometry, hot-pink clashes, minimal black faces and grainy print texture into tea pouring, threading a needle, bowling and a snail.

environment_variables.STYLE_FIDELITY_ANCHORS: Runtime joined CORE and FLEX anchors from this spec
environment_variables.SUBJECT: New character identity and a small number of theme-bearing objects
environment_variables.ACTION: Readable physical interaction and emotional expression
environment_variables.DESIGN_DIRECTION: The case concept and its visible contribution to hierarchy and silhouette
environment_variables.PALETTE_DIRECTION: Roles of saturated colors within the shared chromatic system
environment_variables.MAIN_TEXT: Only visible wording, exact uppercase spelling without added punctuation
environment_variables.SUBJECT_ACTION: the readable physical interaction and emotional expression described in ACTION
environment_variables.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: one or two oversized theme-bearing objects that join the character silhouette
environment_variables.LOCATION: edge-to-edge off-white paper with no scene; depth implied only by overlapping shapes
environment_variables.BACKGROUND_ELEMENTS: bare paper gaps, selective grainy airbrushed shadow and the small black caption
environment_variables.SECONDARY_TEXT: none; MAIN_TEXT is the only visible wording
environment_variables.ACCENT_SYMBOL: the minimal black cut-paper facial marks
environment_variables.WARDROBE_STYLE: flat sculptural garment blocks in hot pink, coral red, cobalt and emerald

style_fidelity_anchors: [CORE] Build a monumental, asymmetric character silhouette from few interlocking circles, flattened capsules, wedges, tapered limbs and large flowing contour cuts; enlarge anatomy according to the emotional gesture.
[CORE] Use nearly black, radically reduced facial marks and weight-bearing accents; eyes, brows and mouth read as deliberately cut graphic shapes rather than detailed drawing.
[CORE] Pair a dominant hot pink or magenta color field with one adjacent warm red or coral gradient and two saturated cool counterweights, on an open off-white paper ground.
[CORE] Keep most shapes flat and crisply bounded, with localized dark-to-color airbrushed shading at overlaps or bends and the specified fine print texture; depth must remain graphic.
[CORE] Let the character-object interaction carry the poster; sparse small bold black uppercase sans-serif copy occupies a useful pocket of negative space.
[FLEX] Change pose, gaze, crop, size relationships and title location to make the action legible; a full body, profile crop, enclosing gesture or reclining arrangement are equally valid.
[FLEX] Let a pouring teapot and cup, giant needle and looping thread, bowling ball and single pin, or spiral snail shell reshape silhouette and paper space with minimal supporting objects.
[FLEX] Recompose portrait and landscape around their available width and height; preserve the case's conceptual relationship while changing overlaps and focal placement.
source_content_to_avoid: The original angry seated man with enormous sideways ear, black side-parted hair and crossed short legs
The two white pointed steam puffs issuing from nostrils
The exact phrase A LITTLE(BIG) MAD. and all source wording
The small oval creator stamp, source signature, watermark or brand identity
The original green sleeves, blue trousers, pink head and large black shoes repeated in the same placement
Part 1 content: saxophone player and puffed cheek, giant pear embrace, umbrella dance, reclining reader and giant book; replace their subjects, actions and wording.
Part 2 content: baker stretching dough, bicycle rider, giant dog and walker, frontal photographer and camera; replace their subjects, actions and captions.
Part 3 content: topiary gardener and shears, freediver with water ribbon, chess player and giant knight, mover with three-box stack; replace these subjects, actions and captions.
Part 4 content: potter and clay vessel, kite flyer, accordion player and stretching cat; replace these subjects, actions and captions.

visual_deconstruction.source_observations: The source enlarges the head and ear into a compressed standing monument. The tiny two-line caption is secondary. Magenta cheeks shift into red forehead; curved black mouth and slanted brows establish anger. Green and cobalt body forms stabilize the composition. White steam marks carve the figure.
visual_deconstruction.reusable_system: Emotion becomes shape, not facial detail. Scale contrast, black cut-shape expressions, complementary saturated blocks, grainy localized gradients and sparse paper space are transferable.
visual_deconstruction.scope: Part 5 continuation: maintain the visual family while changing all sixteen prior concepts. Explore liquid connection, thread loop, low rolling gesture and animal spiral.

composition.hierarchy: Gesture silhouette first, face/object relationship second, small caption third. Keep visual complexity low.
composition.negative_space: Use paper gaps to separate limbs and objects and to carry the caption; no decorative panel framing.
composition.ratio_adaptation: Use the applicable case plan. Portrait may stack or climb; landscape may unfold or stretch. Do not crop a finished portrait to fill the landscape.

typography.family: Compact bold grotesk sans-serif, plain black uppercase
typography.role: Small editorial aside, approximately 4 to 7 percent of image height as a complete text block, subordinate to the illustration
typography.copy: Render MAIN_TEXT verbatim once. Line breaks are flexible; no additional punctuation, byline, labels or fabricated logo.

color_palette.relationships: Hot pink plus warm gradient against emerald and cobalt; roles may shift per case. Use off-white as active negative space and near-black as graphic weight.

image_treatment.medium: Raster illustration with the shape economy of cut-paper and airbrushed screen print
image_treatment.texture: Fine, low-contrast stochastic halftone-like ink stipple and paper tooth, approximately 1 to 3 pixels at a 1500-pixel short edge. Most visible inside saturated and black shapes; very faint in the off-white background. Dark grain concentrates in shaded overlaps. No large scratches, folds, distress or coarse canvas weave.
image_treatment.edges_and_light: Crisp contour silhouettes, softly diffused interior gradient shadows limited to overlaps and volume turns; matte ink, no glossy 3D illumination.

design_rules: Each case must turn its action into a distinct silhouette and meaningful negative-space relationship.
Keep limb and hand anatomy intentionally simplified but physically readable; no accidental extra appendages.
Objects must participate in the gesture at an expressive scale instead of floating as accessories.
Keep the exact short caption clearly readable with generous separation from the focal face and object.
Produce a full-bleed artwork on off-white paper, without a framed mockup or photographic scene.
Keep color count controlled and reduce background detail to marks necessary for the case.
do: Use large asymmetric masses with small facial marks.
Use white gaps as structural parts of the gesture.
Keep texture integrated with ink and preserve clean silhouette contours.
avoid: Copying the source character, angry pose, steam icons or signature.
Photorealistic people, shiny toy renderings, generic cute mascots or outlined cartoons.
Huge headline typography, dense labels, decorative stars and extra logos.
Four identical centered seated poses with different accessories.
negative_prompt: Source angry man, steam puffs, original caption, creator oval stamp, copied identity, watermark, logo, extra text, punctuation, extra limbs, disconnected grips, glossy 3D toy, photorealism, outlined cartoon, coarse weave, distress scratches, huge headline, clutter, frames, poster mockup; no previous saxophone, pear, umbrella, book, dough, bicycle, dog walker, camera, topiary, diver, chess knight or box-stack concepts. No pottery wheel, kite, accordion or stretching cat.

values.SUBJECT: An adult tea maker with a tiny pink face and black cropped hair, emerald torso, enormous hot-pink rounded arm lifting a cobalt teapot with a clear handle, lid and long curved spout above one large emerald teacup.
values.ACTION: One hand grips the teapot handle and tilts the pot; a single narrow dark tea stream connects the spout tip to the open cup below. The other pink hand supports the cup saucer from underneath. Calm closed eyes; no steam, extra cups or table scene.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: The giant arm and hooked spout form an upper curved canopy; a narrow continuous stream crosses a generous white gap to the small cup. A pouring connection rather than an embrace. Keep handle grip and stream endpoints clear.
values.PALETTE_DIRECTION: Pink arm with warm coral bends, cobalt teapot, emerald cup and torso, near-black tea stream, hair and facial marks on off-white paper.
values.PORTRAIT_PLAN: Lift the teapot high above a cup near lower center, using a long vertical white gap crossed by the continuous stream. Tiny head offset beside the arm. Keep spout, handle, whole cup and stream visible; caption in the quiet side pocket.
values.LANDSCAPE_PLAN: Teapot and large curved arm occupy the upper left, cup and supporting hand at lower right. A diagonal descending stream bridges paper space with gravity-readable curve. Small caption above the gap, full spout and cup rim visible.

values.SUBJECT: An intent adult stitcher with a small pink face, black compact hair, emerald sleeves and cobalt trousers, guiding one thick hot-pink thread through the visible oval eye of a giant upright cobalt-blue sewing needle.
values.ACTION: Two simple pink hands guide and pull a single continuous coral-pink thread through the needle eye. The needle rests tip-down on an emerald cloth fold. Thread makes one broad open loop through white space; hands touch the thread beside the eye without obscuring the opening.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: The tall tapered needle is a rigid axis against a generous ribbon-like thread loop and rounded hands. Thread passes visibly through the eye once and remains a continuous line. The small focused face sits beside the eye; no sewing machine or busy fabric pattern.
values.PALETTE_DIRECTION: Hot-pink hands and thread with warm coral at bends, cobalt long needle and trousers, emerald sleeves and simple cloth fold, black hair and tiny expression, off-white paper.
values.PORTRAIT_PLAN: Needle rises vertically through the central height, its whole oval eye high and pointed tip on the low emerald cloth. One open thread loop swings to the side around clear white space. Small face and two hands gather near the eye, caption in the opposite upper pocket.
values.LANDSCAPE_PLAN: Lean the complete needle diagonally from lower left cloth to upper middle eye. An elongated open thread loop travels across the right half with the small stitcher near the eye. Show both hands guiding thread and the eye unobscured; small caption in upper left paper.

values.SUBJECT: A playful adult bowler with a tiny pink face and black hair, huge sweeping hot-pink arm, emerald top, cobalt wide trousers and black shoes, releasing one oversized cobalt bowling ball toward a single emerald bowling pin.
values.ACTION: The crouched bowler swings one hand low behind the ball in a follow-through. The ball rests on a short pink-coral lane strip, with three small near-black finger holes clearly identifying bowling. One isolated pin waits ahead; no extra balls or pin crowd.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Use a low swooping arm and enormous grounded ball as the main mass, with a tiny distant pin establishing direction. A sliver of paper separates the released ball from fingers; the lane is a simple flat geometric wedge, not a realistic alley.
values.PALETTE_DIRECTION: Broad hot-pink arm and face, coral-pink lane strip, cobalt ball and trousers, emerald shirt and single pin with a pink neck band, black shoes, finger holes and face, off-white paper.
values.PORTRAIT_PLAN: Crouched figure folds above a huge low ball, lane wedge recedes upward to one small pin in open paper. Keep ball circle, three holes, released hand and pin fully visible. Small caption in upper-side whitespace.
values.LANDSCAPE_PLAN: Bowler at left folds low with a broad sweeping arm; giant ball in lower middle and single small pin to the right along a low pink lane wedge. Leave a visible release gap between fingers and ball. Exact caption in broad upper whitespace.

values.SUBJECT: One monumental stylized snail with a hot-pink and coral-red spiral shell, a long emerald body and raised head, two simple emerald eye stalks ending in small near-black eyes, gliding over one low cobalt-blue rounded mound.
values.ACTION: The snail stretches its head forward while its underside contacts the mound; tail remains behind. Exactly two eye stalks rise from the head. The shell is one bold inward spiral with a dark granular inner turn, no human face or limbs.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: The shell is an oversized coiled disc balanced on a long low soft body; the small alert eye stalks contrast with the massive spiral. A cobalt mound bends the contact line and gives the snail a gentle journey without scenery.
values.PALETTE_DIRECTION: Hot-pink shell with coral-red outer arc and dark inner spiral shadow, emerald body and eye stalks, cobalt mound, small black eye tips, off-white paper.
values.PORTRAIT_PLAN: Large spiral shell fills the upper middle above the low blue mound, emerald neck reaching up toward the right with both stalks clear. Tail extends left near the base. Full shell, eye tips and tail inside paper margins; caption in upper corner.
values.LANDSCAPE_PLAN: Enormous pink spiral sits left of center and emerald body extends right over a long low blue mound. Two eye stalks rise into the right white pocket, full tail stays left. Caption above the extended neck, no plants or scenery.
